draft.title: Wisp Forest Crossing
draft.briefing: Past the last lantern the trails fork and fold back on themselves. Wolves den among the roots, brigands camp by the black pond, and older things keep the sunken ruins further in. Somewhere past them, a shrine the forest was never meant to give back.
draft.objective: Encontre a passagem e derrote a Planta Carnívora para concluir a travessia.
